name: Planar Halfling
body:
Note Generally more powerful than their Material Plane counterparts, this humanoid variant are more likely be encountered as NPCs but may occasionally be allowed as player characters for high-powered campaigns.

Planar halflings are rare, but are most likely to be found on the Plane of Lawful Good. Much like their cousins on the Material Plane, they are famous for their sense of humor, curiosity, and optimism—but in the case of celestial halflings, this enthusiasm is balanced by great naivety.

Ability Score Modifiers You gain +4 Dex, +2 Cha, –2 Int. This trait alters ability scores.
Languages You begin play speaking Celestial and Halfling. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Abyssal, Common, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, and Infernal. This trait alters languages.
Speed Normal. Your base speed is 30 feet. This trait alters replaces slow speed and weapon familiarity.
Spell-Like Abilities You can use bless and vanish once per day each as spell-like abilities, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability. This trait replaces keen senses.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
